aggregation: Three independent fresh-process runs per arm/mode. Median and min/max of request latency in milliseconds; warm and post-edit remain separate. Memory values are sampled process peaks, not continuous maxima.
limitations: No Neovim or live all-day editor proof.
No claim that all composition costs are improved.
Unrelated editor servers and Vite were left running; not a fully idle host.
In-memory newline edits and a separate semantic application guard do not represent arbitrary source edits.
Native process cleanup may record a nonzero exit after the harness terminates its owned LSP process; Passed requires successful requests and cleanup guards, not exit code zero.
